scene1Childhood.sillyTrouble: launching baking soda rockets that landed in Mrs. Gable's prized petunia bed
scene1Childhood.weirdObsession: drawing elaborate superhero blueprints in my spiral notebook

scene2TeenFreedom.freedomMachine: a rattle-trap sky blue 1974 Volkswagen Beetle
scene2TeenFreedom.secretTeenIdentity: drumming in a terribly loud garage rock band called The Sparks

scene3LeapOfFaith.riskOrAdventure: moving across the country with two suitcases and sixty dollars to open my clock workshop
scene3LeapOfFaith.triumphMoment: the day the town square church bell chimed after I spent all night fixing its gears

scene4Romance.howWeMet: we both reached for the very same vintage jazz record at Murray's Music Shop
scene4Romance.awkwardDateMoment: dropping my ice cream cone straight onto my shoes on our first boardwalk walk
scene4Romance.theMomentIKnew: when she laughed until tears came out and offered me half her cone

scene5LegacyFinale.whatIWishKidsUnderstood: every gray hair was earned having the absolute time of my life with your mother and you kids
scene5LegacyFinale.timeMachineMessageToChildSelf: don't hurry growing up so fast little buddy, the quiet ordinary days are the magical ones
